explanation:
> “Since every point of $U_X(\overline{\mathbb Q})^{\le d}$ clearly lifts to a point of $U_Y(\overline{\mathbb Q})^{\le d^{\prime}}$, this completes the verification of the claim.”

— Shinichi Mochizuki, *Arithmetic Elliptic Curves in General Position*, proof of Theorem 2.1, printed p.12.

**English**

Choose an integer N>max(3,3(1+epsilon)/epsilon). Then a=(N-3)/N>0 and delta=a(1+epsilon)-1>0. Lift each tripod point to the actual Fermat curve by the degree/discriminant child; apply the canonical estimate at degree N^2*d and error delta; use the fixed projective-height normalization child. Dividing the resulting inequality by a yields Statement I with constant ((1+delta)*C_D+C_F+C_N)/a, chosen before the point. This reduction retains the three Open mathematical children, including the still-to-be-decomposed Belyi, compactness and adjunction chain.

Shinichi Mochizuki, Arithmetic Elliptic Curves in General Position, Theorem 2.1 (printed pp.11–13), Propositions 1.4, 1.6, 1.7; https://www.kurims.kyoto-u.ac.jp/~motizuki/Arithmetic%20Elliptic%20Curves%20in%20General%20Position.pdf . Source epsilon bookkeeping Genl/GeneralPosition/TheoremTwoOne.lean:146. Choose N>max(3,3(1+epsilon)/epsilon), a=(N-3)/N and delta=a(1+epsilon)-1>0. The three precise children yield the parent StatementI from StatementII with a uniform additive constant. This proves only their conditional combination.

**简体中文**

先选自然数 N 大于 3 与 3(1+epsilon)/epsilon 的最大值，使 a=(N-3)/N 为正、delta=a(1+epsilon)-1 为正。利用提升与不同理想估计子定理把每个三支点曲线上的点提升到实际 Fermat 曲线，将规范高度估计用于次数界 N²d 和误差 delta，再用固定射影高度的归一化子定理。所得不等式除以正数 a，即得到命题一，且加法常数在选点之前确定。三个子定理仍开放，其中 Belyi 映射、局部紧性与伴随公式还需继续展开。

**日本語**

自然数 N を 3 と 3(1+epsilon)/epsilon の最大値より大きく選ぶと、a=(N-3)/N と delta=a(1+epsilon)-1 は正となる。持ち上げと不同の評価により三点を除いた射影直線の各点を実際の Fermat 曲線へ持ち上げ、次数上限 N²d と誤差 delta で標準的高さの評価を適用し、固定した射影的高さの正規化を用いる。得られた不等式を正数 a で割ると命題一となり、加法定数は点に先立って選ばれる。三つの子定理は未証明であり、Belyi 写像、局所コンパクト性、随伴公式に関する連鎖はさらに分解する。
